title: Montana's 68,315 location rows now roll up to privacy-safe project denominators
summary: FTFN reconciled all 68,315 Final Proposal BSL location rows to the 32 project IDs and publishes project-level totals plus raw classification and technology-code distributions without exposing individual BSL identifiers. Denominator: Exactly 68,315 location-file rows; raw classification codes 0 and 1 total 45,401 and 22,914, and raw technology codes total the same 68,315 rows.
